subject: Waterway information - Broken Pipe - Haro Strait
text:
Waterway information - Broken Pipe - Haro Strait
A broken ABS pipe has been reported in Tsehum Harbour in the vicinity of 48 40.251N 123 24.413W mid-channel near the entrance to Van Isle Marina. The pipe is a black ABS pipe extending 4-6 feet out of the water.
Caution.
